about.heading: About me
about.lead: Growth marketer and builder — I run campaigns, ship sites, and wire tracking so you see the full picture.
paragraphs: I've spent the last several years helping brands turn search and paid media into steady leads, then making sure those leads land on pages that actually convert.
When I'm not in ad accounts or Analytics, I'm sketching flows in Figma or pushing clean Next.js builds. One thread through it all: fewer hand-offs, clearer numbers.
